claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament is April 6–12.
Featured groups and Amen Corner streaming are available on Masters.com.
TV coverage runs 3–7:30 p.m. ET on ESPN on Thursday and Friday for the 2026 Masters Tournament.
TV coverage runs 3–7:30 p.m. ET on CBS on Saturday and Sunday for the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Early streaming coverage is available on Prime Video for the 2026 Masters Tournament.
Practice Rounds for the 2026 Masters Tournament are on Monday to Wednesday.
On the Range coverage is 12–2 p.m. on Monday on Masters.com, CBS Sports, Paramount+.
On the Range coverage is 9–11 a.m. on Tuesday and Wednesday on Masters.com, CBS Sports, Paramount+.
Par 3 Contest is on Wednesday.
Par 3 Contest streaming is 12–4 p.m. on Wednesday on Masters.com, the Masters App, ESPN+.
Par 3 Contest TV coverage is 2–4 p.m. on Wednesday on ESPN.
Tournament Rounds for the 2026 Masters Tournament are on Thursday to Sunday.
Round 1 and Round 2 coverage is 1–3 p.m. on Prime Video on Thursday and Friday.
Round 1 and Round 2 coverage is 3–7:30 p.m. on ESPN on Thursday and Friday.
Round 3 and Round 4 coverage is 2–7 p.m. on CBS on Saturday and Sunday.
Round 3 and Round 4 have early coverage on Paramount+.
Featured Groups coverage is available all day on Masters.com, the Masters App, and Paramount+ all week.
Amen Corner coverage is available all day on Masters.com, the Masters App, and Paramount+ all week.
Prime Video offers "Key Moments" feature new for 2026.
Prime Video offers "Rapid Recap" feature new for 2026.
Masters.com and the Masters App provide free coverage of Amen Corner, featured groups, and holes 4, 5, 6, 15, and 16.
ESPN offers early round TV coverage.
CBS offers weekend TV coverage.
Paramount+ offers live stream of CBS.
Amazon Prime Video provides special afternoon coverage for the first two rounds.
All coverage times are subject to change.
